environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4 only). Instance runs in a private subnet with security group allowing inbound TCP/8080 from the NLB target group. No application-layer inspection. Flask app served directly via Gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database on local EBS volume. Environment variable HMAC_SECRET set but only used for write endpoints (not relevant to GET-based exploit).

config.network: Private subnet, SG allows TCP/8080 from NLB only
config.database: SQLite 3.40 on local EBS gp3 volume
